title: Clinical Performance Analytics Dashboard
summary: Tracks health operations KPIs such as no-show rates, patient wait times and provider utilisation.
problem: Health operations teams need to see no-show rates, wait times and provider utilisation in one place.
objective: Define the core clinical operations KPIs and track them in an interactive dashboard.
approach: Defined the KPIs, built the dashboard in Power BI, and applied data privacy best practice throughout.
process: Defined KPIs for no-show rates, patient wait times and provider utilisation
Applied data privacy best practice throughout
impact: Demonstrates readiness for health analytics roles.
